messages:
mira_cs: Quick alert 1025-04-11: HorizonPark usage fell ~92% right after their IdP cutover this morning. Billing looks unchanged but their nightly model jobs stopped. Can we triage? :alarm_clock:
leo_csm: Saw the drop. They filed ticket HP-824 and said some endpoints return 401s and occasional 502s. Procurement is asking for a mitigation plan within 48h. I tried reaching their new ML lead (carlos) but no reply yet.
toby_solutions: Offered a short live walkthrough + temporary sandbox creds to unblock testing. Customer asked for a focused checklist for SSO-related failure modes. I can draft one.
anya_eng: From our traces: spikes of 401 at 02:29-02:35 UTC, followed by routing fallback events. Looks like token exchange or header munging during their SSO redirect. If they can paste one raw request/response we can reproduce locally.
mira_cs: Copy of customer message in HP-824: "After migrating to IDP-X, our inference jobs either return 401 or hang until 502. We're evaluating alternatives if this persists. We need a remediation plan by EOD Friday." They also mentioned a competitor trial in parallel.
leo_csm: That competitor bit is the immediate risk. Sales asked if we can offer a 14-day dedicated pool as a bridge while we fix auth. Any objections?
toby_solutions: I'm OK with a short trial paired with a guarded playbook (no discounts beyond the trial). We should document rollback and how to re-point tokens. I'll assemble the one-pager with steps: sample payload, where to check kvcache, retry logic, alternate auth endpoint.
anya_eng: Technical note to include in the one-pager:
```
Example failure:
REQUEST -> 401 Unauthorized
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Trace: auth-exchange-failed -> kvcache-miss -> routing-fallback -> 502
```
We can enable an auth-proxy and a temporary sandbox key for HorizonPark. Engineering ETA ~5h after customer sign-off.
mira_cs: Plan of attack: 1) Leo loop sales/procurement and confirm limited 14-day dedicated offer. 2) Toby prepares SSO checklist + walkthrough slides. 3) Anya builds the proxy and test key standby. 4) Mira schedules a 30-min troubleshoot session with the ML lead and invites eng + solutions.
ops-bot: Ticket HP-824 updated by mira_cs at 2025-04-11T09:18Z
leo_csm: I'll ping procurement and add a short commercial note: "priority onboarding and 14-day dedicated capacity at no charge, contingent on signed mitigation acknowledgement." Will escalate if procurement asks for longer.
toby_solutions: Dropping draft checklist here now (short):
- Ask HorizonPark to paste a raw failing request/response (headers & body).
- Try rotating service token; test token exchange via curl.
- If 401s persist, enable alternate auth endpoint for 48h and run smoke jobs.
- Confirm kvcache warmup and retry/backoff params in their client (60s -> 3 retries).
mira_cs: I'll send calendar invite for 14:00 HorizonPark local time. Include Anya + Toby + Leo. Once they accept we'll enable proxy after they approve. Keep the thread posted. :thumbsup:
